summary: Prudential plc filed a Form 6-K reporting an open-market share repurchase of 635,107 ordinary shares at an average price of 11.0452 GBP per share from JP Morgan Securities plc under an existing buyback program. The shares are to be cancelled, reducing total shares outstanding. This is a routine capital return via a standard issuer buyback, not a special situation such as a tender offer, going-private transaction, or activist campaign. The filing merely discloses daily buyback activity consistent with the authority granted at the 2025 AGM. No unusual terms, premium, or strategic shift is indicated; it is an ordinary-course share repurchase.
